torment_rift.name: Torment Rift
torment_rift.help:
Daily free challenges are limited.
Leaving mid fight still counts as a challenge attempt.
The ranking is reset daily. Higher damage means better rewards.
The first 1,000 players at the Resonating Altar can join the Elite groups instead of the Normal groups for boosted rewards.
torment_rift.unlock: Clear Odyssey Stage 9-3 to unlock Torment Rift.

grim_surge.name: Grim Surge
grim_surge.help:
Sailors get a set number of free challenges daily.
Challenge attempts will not be refunded if you quit mid-battle.

old_gods_calamity.name: Old God's Calamity
old_gods_calamity.help:
The first Traveler on the server clearing Odyssey Chapter 20, 30, 40, and 50 awakens an old god, Typhon, and locks following stages.
All Travelers on the server must defeat Typhon together to continue their Odyssey.
Everyone can perform 3 challenges daily and all damage dealt are recorded.
Rewards will be issued after the kill of Typhon based on damage dealt.

old_gods_return.name: Old God's Return
old_gods_return.help:
Old God Return is a weekly recurring event. You need Challenge Coupons earned from quests to take part.
Server Rewards: When enough total DMG is dealt to the boss, rewards will be available to all players.
Leaderboard: During the event, players are ranked by total DMG dealt to the boss. After the event, rewards will be issued via in-game mail based on players' final ranks.

103/1001.name: Calamity's Tear
103/1001.description: An item required to activate Buds on the Beacon Tree. Obtained from the Torment Rift. A sincere tear shed as the Calamity fades. It bears its final remorse, and nurtures the hope of rebirth.

103/1006001.name: Epic Nomos Cube

103/1009.name: Godcall Plume

103/1010.name: Godcall Pinion
103/1010.description: An item that can be used in Suit Summon to obtain a random Deity. Bathed in golden radiance, the wandering raven finds its path, guiding you to the deities of a certain Suit and awakening their slumbering might.

103/1011.name: Star Tracer
103/1011.description: Used for summoning in Chronos Chamber. It crawls through the seams of time, devouring the past to shape the future, bringing you ancient whispers.

103/1013.name: Luminous Key
103/1013.description: Used for summoning in the Wheel of Fate in Totem. The Wheel of Fate keeps on turning, divine virtues surface from deep within the samsara and gather in your hands as newfound power.

103/1031.name: Random Celestial Deity Shard

103/1032.name: Elite Divine Exchange Token
